name: crypto-threat-map
description: Interactive map showing physical attack risk for cryptocurrency holders worldwide

scripts.pipeline: node data/pipeline/01-fetch-incidents.mjs && node data/pipeline/02-geocode.mjs && node data/pipeline/03-classify.mjs && node data/pipeline/04-aggregate.mjs
scripts.pipeline:publish: npm run pipeline && cp data/generated/incidents.json data/generated/country-risk.json data/generated/us-state-risk.json data/generated/meta.json public/data/
